<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Shipping" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/shipping">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OfferRequest" name="Request for offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offer" name="Offer"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Shipping">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ShippingProcess" name="Shipping process" processRef="Process_Shipping"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsCompanies" name="Three logistics companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OfferRequest" name="Request offers" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsCompanies" messageRef="Message_OfferRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Offers" sourceRef="Participant_LogisticsCompanies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shipping" name="Shipping" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_GoodsToShip" name="Goods shall be shipped"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ClarifyShipping" name="Secretary clarifies who will do the shipping"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShippingAndPackaging_Split" name="Arrange shipping and package goods"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Amount" name="Amount of goods?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InviteCompanies" name="Secretary invites three logistics companies to make offers" messageRef="Message_OfferRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive offers from three logistics companies" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCompany" name="Secretary selects one logistics company"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NormalPost" name="Use normal post shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ShippingMethod_Merge" name="Shipping method selected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WriteLabel" name="Secretary writes package label"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsuranceNeeded" name="Is parcel insurance necessary?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeInsurance" name="Logistics department head takes parcel insurance"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Insurance_Merge" name="Insurance decision complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackageGoods" name="Warehousemen package goods"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShippingAndPackaging_Join" name="Shipping arrangements and packaging ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePickup" name="Prepare packaged goods for pickup by the logistics company"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup" name="Goods prepared for pickup by the logistics company"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_GoodsToShip" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipping" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingAndPackaging_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingAndPackaging_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Amount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingAndPackaging_Split" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount" targetRef="Task_InviteCompanies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">large amounts</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_Amount" targetRef="Task_NormalPost">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">small amounts</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_SelectCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_SelectCompany" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingMethod_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_NormalPost" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingMethod_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingMethod_Merge" targetRef="Task_WriteLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_WriteLabel" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" name="Necessary" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceNeeded" targetRef="Task_TakeInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insurance is necessary</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" name="Not necessary" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceNeeded" targetRef="Gateway_Insurance_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insurance is not necessary</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_TakeInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_Insurance_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_Insurance_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingAndPackaging_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_ShippingAndPackaging_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_ShippingAndPackaging_Join" targetRef="Task_PreparePickup"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_PreparePickup" targetRef="EndEvent_ReadyForPickup"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
